items.title: The New Mexico 2040 Plan
items.description: Preserves NMDOT's previous statewide long-range multimodal plan, establishing goals, performance measures, strategies, and investment direction for safety, asset condition, mobility, access, stewardship, and accountability through 2040.

items.large_file_assessment: The exact file is 37,531,114 bytes (35.79 MiB), unusually large because its 217 pages contain statewide maps, charts, tables, photographs, and technical figures. It is the authoritative Library of Congress preservation copy; no smaller authoritative version was found. Optimization would alter the preserved source. Projected R2 storage after the six-volume batch is 3,308,921,339 bytes.
